segments.text: Morning Mr Patel. Your blood pressure is still a bit high today.
I am adding atenolol, fifty milligrams, to help with your blood pressure.
Take it once a day, in the morning.
It may cause tiredness or cold hands for the first few weeks.
Come back next month so we can check your pressure again.
